name: Triad Of One
source:
Triad of One is a visual novel about three bodies (corpses) controlled by a mystery fourth entity; The "entity" who control these, otherwise soulless bodies, make uses the "shadow memories", the skills, the capabilities and even flaws to affirm its will. The elven maiden will provide its Intelligence (INT), the tough dwarf will provide (both physical and attitudinal) Strength (STR) while the last one... the human, will provide Dexterity (DEX).

But "they" will not use these skills for fight, but obtain information from various NPCs across the lands. Each skills will offer two talking options (for a total of six): one of them will allow you to advance, while the wrong one will antagonize the NPC you're talking with... so, pick careful, don't haste, take your time... what the NPCs says will be always the clue for the next right answer! You won't get to pick (or even read) your exact words to use, instead a fix and clear set of choice will represent the approach (and who among the tree) you will take with each NPC. 

[From [url=https://fortoj.itch.io/triad-of-one] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Triad of One是一部关于由神秘的第四个实体控制的三个身体（尸体）的视觉小说；控制这些原本没有灵魂的身体的“实体”，利用“影子记忆”、技能、能力甚至缺陷来确认其意志。精灵少女将提供智力（INT），坚韧的矮人将提供（身体和态度）力量（STR），而最后一个……人类将提供敏捷（DEX）。

但“他们”不会用这些技能来战斗，而是从各地的各个NPC那里获取信息。每个技能都会提供两种对话选项（总共六种）：其中一种可以让你前进，而错误的一种则会与你正在交谈的NPC对抗……所以，小心选择，不要着急，慢慢来……NPC所说的永远是下一个正确答案的线索！你无法选择（甚至阅读）要使用的确切单词，而是一组固定且清晰的选择将代表你对每个NPC采取的方法（以及树中的谁）。

[来自[url=https://fortoj.itch.io/triad-of-one] itch.io[/url]]
